tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background. The sidebar and status line sit directly on it.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Content panel, agent panel, boxes and tables. A clear step above bg in both themes.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Buttons, menus, toasts, palette, hovered table rows.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover and current state for nav items, menu items and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Soft borders and dividers between rows and panels.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: buttons, inputs, segmented controls.

tokens.name: line-heavy
tokens.usage: Unchecked checkbox and radio borders, input hover.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, panel and raised. 15:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, nav items, table headers and secondary columns. About 8:1 on panel.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Meta text only: timestamps, captions, axis ticks. About 6:1 on panel in both themes.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, checked controls. Inverted against the theme, one per view.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2 px solid with a 2 px gap. 3:1 or better against bg and panel.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Working states (snapshotting, uploading), progress fills, selected table rows at 7%.

tokens.name: running
tokens.usage: Status dot for Running and healthy. Healthy text itself stays text-2.

tokens.name: running-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind success banners, added diff lines and Healthy tags.

tokens.name: degraded
tokens.usage: Degraded status, warnings, capacity at 80% or more. Text-safe on panel in both themes.

tokens.name: degraded-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind attention rows, warning banners and WARN log lines.

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: Down status dots, destructive fills, capacity at 95% or more.

tokens.name: down-text
tokens.usage: Error and destructive text. Use instead of down for words.

tokens.name: down-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind error banners, destructive buttons, removed diff lines.

tokens.name: stopped
tokens.usage: Hollow status ring for Stopped and Stale. Always paired with the word.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 and the first segment of allocation bars.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5. Use at most five series; group the rest as Other.

tokens.name: terminal
tokens.usage: Embedded terminal surface. Near-black in both themes.

tokens.name: terminal-text
tokens.usage: Text in the embedded terminal.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles inside the content panel. One per page.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section headings. 32 px above, 10 px below.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: honcho has restarted 4 times in 10 minutes.
styles.usage: Default interface text, table cells, buttons.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Emphasised body: row titles, attention items, field labels in dense forms.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Timestamps, captions, table headers, helper text.

styles.name: prose
styles.usage: Docs, runbooks and agent reports, 68 characters wide.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Addresses, IDs, ports, versions, commands and aligned figures only.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps in tight clusters.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Base unit. Icon to badge.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between tags.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Within a group: icon and label, buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section heading to its content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Row padding, gap between list items.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding, gap between fields.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Content panel side padding, form field rows.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between columns.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Between major sheet sections in documentation.

tokens.usage: Tags, inline code, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the command palette.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, count badges, avatars.

tokens.usage: The only shadow. Menus, tooltips, toasts, palette, dialogs and drawers.
